name: Boulderslide Ravine
summary: Along Webwinder Path, secluded Boulderslide Ravine cuts through the central peaks of the Stonetalon Mountains. The ravine has seen little of the fighting between Horde and Alliance. Its rocky slopes lead toward Boulderslide Cavern, while wild mountain beasts still roam there.

sections.title: A Quiet Mountain Pass
sections.body: Boulderslide Ravine lies off Webwinder Path in the Stonetalon heights. Loggers, night elves, and the Horde battle over timber and sacred glades elsewhere in the region, but military forces rarely disturb this narrow pass. Mountain rams and crag beasts such as Cliff Stormers roam its ledges and sheer stone walls. Prospectors watch the slopes, where rich mineral veins often surface along the way toward the deeper cavern network.

sections.title: Traces in the Stone
sections.body: Across from Boulderslide Cavern's entrance, a small cave overlooks the ravine. Rough torches light its weathered supply barrels and primitive tribal paintings. The crude designs resemble ancient tauren art, suggesting native tribes once traveled through these crags or found temporary shelter here, long before modern conflict reached the mountains.

aliases: how to get to boulderslide ravine
faq.answer: Boulderslide Ravine lies in the Stonetalon Mountains. Follow Webwinder Path into the higher crags to reach it.
Mountain rams and crag beasts inhabit the ravine. Cliff Stormers are among the dangerous crag beasts found there.

faq.q: What is the abandoned cave across from Boulderslide Cavern?
faq.answer: Across from Boulderslide Cavern's entrance, a small cave holds old barrels and burns with torchlight. Tribal pictographs cover its stone walls and resemble tauren art, suggesting local wanderers or hunters once used the shelter.
Boulderslide Ravine leads toward Boulderslide Cavern, a subterranean lair deep in the mountains. Its slopes also offer valuable mineral outcroppings to travelers passing through.

angles.text: As a miner, you can look for veins exposed along the ravine's steep walls as the mountain's stone shifts.
As a tauren, you may recognize the faded tribal designs in the small side cave. They hint at ancestral paths through the Stonetalon heights.
